description: The shared devkit policy, PINNED to a release tag (it moves only through a reviewed PR here), then THIS repository's automerge decisions, which come after the preset so the preset cannot widen them.

packageRules.description: Nothing merges itself unless a rule below says so.
GitHub's own actions (actions/*): a PATCH release at least 5 days old may merge itself once ci / gate and disclose / gate pass. Third-party actions and digest-only updates are always reviewed.
Galaxy content runs on the privileged controller and is not hash-locked: always reviewed.
